items.title: Blue Raiders drop weeknight finale to Kennesaw
items.summary: MURFREESBORO, Tenn.- On its final weeknight game of the season Middle Tennessee (4-4, 2-2 CUSA) lost momentum in the second half, falling to Kennesaw State (2-6, 1-3 CUSA) 44-28.

items.title: Countdown to Kickoff Luncheon set for Tuesday
items.summary: MURFREESBORO, Tenn. — Middle Tennessee football fans will have an opportunity to get an inside look at Wednesday's conference matchup with Kennesaw State when the Blue Raiders host the Countdown to Kickoff Luncheon Tuesday, Oct. 27, at 11:45 a.m. in the SRM Concrete Club at Floyd Stadium.

items.title: Former MTSU football coach and hall of fame member Ed Bunio dies at 85
items.summary: The former Blue Raider coach served the team for 16 years and was inducted into the MTSU Hall of Fame in 2010.

items.title: Bourgeois earns second CUSA Special Teams Player of the Week honor
items.summary: MURFREESBORO – Senior place-kicker Dominic Bourgeois was voted the CUSA Special Teams Player of the Week as announced by the league office on Monday. This marks the second honor for Bourgeois this season.

items.title: Brown Jr.'s career-night fuels Blue Raider win at FIU
items.summary: MIAMI- Middle Tennessee football (4-3, 2-1 CUSA) won a pivotal matchup on the road Tuesday night, taking down Conference USA foe FIU (3-4, 1-2 CUSA) 26-23.

items.title: Gagliano named CUSA Offensive Player of the Week
items.summary: MURFREESBORO – Redshirt sophomore Roman Gagliano was voted the CUSA Offensive Player of the Week as announced by the league office on Monday. Gagliano is the fourth Blue Raider this year to earn a CUSA award.

items.title: Logan named to Ray's 8 for Week 7
items.summary: AUGUSTA, Ga. – Middle Tennessee Football punter Ashton Logan has been named to Ray's 8 for Week 7 following a standout week against Delaware, the Ray Guy Award announced Monday.
